construction: The four schedules extend only the two PG209 Puruṣakāra profiles. The two futures retain the causative ay before iṭ. The conditional adds the augment inside ni. The P benedictive loses ṇic before the aniṭ ārddhadhātuka ending and retains the chosen root grade.
bare_table: Both grades occur in the same unprefixed face of the 01.0929 archive. Each of the 72 selected components was found in its corresponding person and number. No prefixed future or blessing is attributed to these lexical witnesses.
